summary: Title dispute over Asman Jahi Paigah properties; partition suit leading to final decree for 84.30 guntas; contempt proceedings against Tahsildar for non-mutation; High Court initially upheld contempt but later recalled order via intra-court review; State's contention of suit being withdrawn against Government upheld as valid; escheat claim without statutory basis; unclean hands doctrine applied; review improperly entertained on merits; Letters Patent appeal and contempt appeal properly allowed by first Division Bench.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court's review order set aside; Letters Patent Appeal and Contempt Appeal allowed by first Division Bench restored.
